name: GetCardMetadataByte
evidence: Reads one byte from 0x020A1258 + card_id * 4 + field_index.

name: SelectGateBattleType
evidence: Calls GetCardMetadataByte with field index 2 and returns the fixed type ID.

name: StoreSelectedBattleType
evidence: Stores fallback selector result to battle object byte +0x20.

name: ApplyBattleTypeOverride
evidence: Maps battle-data override codes 1-6 to fixed type IDs.

name: DispatchBattleType
evidence: Validates type 0-5 and dispatches to one of six minigame constructors.
